notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Martyr for the Cause, adding {C}{C}.
When Martyr for the Cause dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Martyr for the Cause from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
